description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'DateTimeDatelistWidget' for a date/time selection widget with configurable settings and form rendering logic.

classes.name: DateTimeDatelistWidget
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class implementing a date/time list widget with customizable settings and form elements.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default configuration settings for the widget, including increment, date order, and time type.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Builds the form element for date/time selection, configuring date order, time type, and increments.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Provides a form for configuring widget settings such as date order, time type, and increments.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of current widget settings for display.
